message: Brain alignment is robustly measurable but not an inducible per-individual training lever beyond perplexity.

claims.text: The LM-to-brain alignment signal is real beyond confounds on real fMRI.
claims.scope: single-subject UTS03, 11442 reliable voxels, contiguous story-CV
acknowledgments: Evidence is single-subject; cross-subject generalization untested.

claims.text: Optimizing the brain loss yields no per-individual brain-specific alignment gain over perplexity-only KD.
acknowledgments: Undemonstrated, not proven zero (powered null at the tested MDE).

warrants.warrant: A measurable signal need not be a gradient-accessible lever.
